scope: Static production configuration only; no deployment or provider acceptance

checks.action: Use an owned fixed public HTTPS origin in site.json
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL must equal site.origin
Run with NODE_ENV=production
Remove SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION
Set LOCAL_TEST_AUTH_ENABLED=false explicitly
Set UI_STUDIO_ENABLED=false explicitly
Generate an independent auth secret of at least 32 characters
Configure Google OAuth or verified-sender email sign-in
Enabled Google sign-in needs client ID and secret
Enabled email sign-in needs Resend key and bare sender email
Configure a dedicated PostgreSQL database/user/password
Set DATABASE_SSL_MODE=require; verify managed database TLS separately
Configure private S3/R2 storage, public access disabled
Configure HTTPS private S3/R2 endpoint without credentials/path
Configure bucket, region and bucket-scoped read/write keys
Generate a separate 32-byte hex backup key and retain it outside backups
Keep unique site ID, cookie prefix and file namespace
Replace local support/privacy email addresses
Enabled summary tool requires configured text executor
Use a public HTTPS text API base URL
Enabled video tool requires configured Kie executor/model
Configure all enabled PAYPAL credentials, verification and product mappings
Use PAYPAL production mode only after separate platform acceptance
Configure all enabled WAFFO credentials, verification and product mappings
Use WAFFO production mode only after separate platform acceptance
WAFFO_RETURN_BASE_URL must belong to this site's fixed HTTPS origin
PAYPAL_WEBHOOK_URL must belong to this site's fixed HTTPS origin
WAFFO_WEBHOOK_URL must belong to this site's fixed HTTPS origin

deferred: Owned HTTPS/DNS and real OAuth/email callbacks
Private bucket policy and live object probe
Database migrations, verified Owner and Worker readiness
Per-channel products, real signed callbacks, payments/refunds and reconciliation
Offsite backup restoration, rollback and operations acceptance
